terra.problem: Calling this the heaviest answer of Amos's day asserts a comparison the text does not make.
The confetti joke makes light of the wailing in a verse that also describes many deaths.
The timer comparison makes cheating people the punchline, making light of serious wrongdoing.
Saying he is impressed by the planning makes a light remark about the planned exploitation.
The text does not say the land's movement makes it impossible to stand still.
The final sentence states that it is a family's mourning for an only son. The LORD says it will be like such mourning.
Saying their swearing did not give them anything solid to stand on adds an idea of protection the text does not state.
